question: Which selected city-update calls refresh or can reach persistent credits, and do the accepted turn paths establish an unconditional once-per-city credit event?

scope.boundary: This result inventories raw direct branch-and-link words to the accepted city-update owner, verifies seven selected call modes, and maps local cached-versus-recomputing turn decisions. It does not classify every caller, all branch inputs, full turn iteration, actual credit cadence, or runtime behavior.

dependencies.use: Provides entry-mode one and mode-minus-one boundaries, the actual reserve writer, and the accepted cached and mode-zero turn paths.
Identifies the current turn word at 0x8312B8DC and the accepted turn-transition owner.
Provides the Library-conditioned value, distinct city result fields, and mode-minus-one read-side recomputation.

directCallInventory.qualification: Only the site at 0x82CEE0BC has a decoded instruction and modeled owner in the configured listing. Generated windows identify the two already accepted owners of the seven selected sites. The other seventeen calls are not assigned modes or semantics.

modeConsequences.recursive: The selected self-calls at 0x82D13B38 and 0x82D13B5C pass mode one, which bypasses the selected yield and reserve-credit block. The self-calls at 0x82D1644C and 0x82D16A78 pass mode -1, which can refresh selected city values but branches past the selected reserve credit.
modeConsequences.turn: All three selected calls in CalendarTurnAdvance pass mode zero. They are conditional callsites, not an unconditional three-call sequence or three observed credits. They can enter the continuing credit path established by city-yield-state-credit, subject to its entry paths and later native overrides.

turnDecisions.firstCachedPath: At 0x82D1FA48..0x82D1FA74, a nonzero retained byte predicate, an odd low bit of current turn plus retained city index r25, or signed current turn below twenty branches to 0x82D1FAE0. The local continuing cached path consumes city +0x48 and branches at 0x82D1FADC to 0x82D1FC18, bypassing the first mode-zero call at 0x82D1FC14.
turnDecisions.firstCallBypass: On the selected path reaching 0x82D1FBC8, a nonzero retained byte predicate or nonzero halfword at the base pointer loaded from stack +0x78 reaches 0x82D1FC0C. Otherwise an odd current turn also reaches that call block, while an even turn at least twenty branches at 0x82D1FC08 to 0x82D1FC18. The halfword is indexed by the value saved at stack +0x1E4 multiplied by 32; its meaning remains unassigned.
turnDecisions.laterCalls: The local branch at 0x82D1FD14 can bypass the mode-zero call at 0x82D1FD20, and the branch at 0x82D1FDBC can bypass the mode-zero call at 0x82D1FDC8. Their arithmetic inputs and enclosing paths are not classified as scheduling intervals or player-facing rules.
turnDecisions.qualification: These are selected local branch facts. The two retained byte predicates, indexed halfword meaning, complete city/owner selection, branch composition, and frequency remain unresolved. Bypassing 0x82D1FC14 does not prove that a whole turn performs no later city update or reserve credit.

runtimeObservation.qualification: No native update invocation, gold credit, city-turn frequency, Chinese Library bonus, or gameplay behavior was observed or changed.

currentEvidence.method: Two shared foreground read-only invocations: the raw direct-caller inventory and a selected word read. This topic's eleven radius-24 word windows emitted 539 rows covering 476 unique words. All 24 city-update call words and every selected context row matched the supported flat image. Exact-function generated windows corroborated the selected call modes and branch joins.
currentEvidence.qualification: Selected sites have exact generated instruction locators. Window bounds describe the queried words, not a continuous complete function or turn loop. No additional callee or indirect target was expanded. Generated code is corroboration, not independent authority.

guards: Do not award a per-turn bonus on every city-update entry: selected mode-one and mode-minus-one calls are not selected reserve-credit events.
Do not treat the first mode-zero turn call as the only native city-update call in that owner.
Do not infer three credits, no later credit after a cached branch, or once-per-city cadence from these selected callsites.
Do not identify the retained predicates or indexed halfword as Chinese civilization identity.
Do not infer a safe plugin arithmetic contract, runtime result, presentation parity, or save/load acceptance from these static gates.
conclusion: The raw inventory contains 24 direct city-update calls. Four selected recursive calls use non-crediting modes one or -1; three selected turn-owner calls use mode zero under local gates. Cached and bypass paths can skip the first turn call without proving absence of later calls or credits. A supported fixed gold bonus still requires the exact city/owner scheduling contract and runtime acceptance.
